scope: Shared read-only observer on retained Windows Server 2022 and 2025 CPU instances; not network/GPU qualification
schema: Hashed public identities, endpoints, byte counters and lastHandshakeFiletime; exact allowed peer fields checked
limitations: No mitigation or new qualification of the known Windows UDP loss is established.
Native samples validate reading current adapters; they do not measure uninterrupted traffic.
The observer binary was not instrumented for native runtime coverage.
